api_token.description: The Vercel API Token to use. This can also be specified with the `VERCEL_API_TOKEN` shell environment variable. Tokens can be created from your [Vercel settings](https://vercel.com/account/tokens).

team.description: The default Vercel Team to use when creating resources. This can be provided as either a team slug, or team ID. The slug and ID are both available from the Team Settings page in the Vercel dashboard.

block.description:
The Vercel provider is used to interact with resources supported by Vercel.
The provider needs to be configured with the proper credentials before it can be used.

Use the navigation to the left to read about the available resources.
Retrieves information about member user in given team
